correctness.rationale: For fixed supports \(S,T\), vanishing outside \(T\) gives a kernel of the Fourier submatrix with rows in the complement of \(T\). Exact nonzero time coordinates are possible precisely when deleting each selected column leaves rank unchanged, and exact nonzero desired Fourier coordinates are possible precisely when adjoining each desired row raises rank by one. Over \(\mathbf C\), finitely many proper kernels cannot cover the nonzero kernel, so these conditions are jointly sufficient. The inspected verifier implements all ranks exactly over \(\mathbf Q(\zeta_8)\) and exhausts all \(65{,}025\) support pairs and both finite symmetry actions. Independently, the displayed matrix sums to \(20{,}929\), is symmetric, and both reported orbit-size distributions sum back to \(20{,}929\) with respectively \(205\) and \(108\) classes.
